summary.business_type: B2B software / product studio (agency), Saudi market; site not yet deployed
top_findings: Placeholder awards, team, reviews, phone, address and stats are live in the build
Single-URL site: no service, case-study, blog, privacy or terms pages
No robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical, Open Graph or Twitter tags
All 9 autoplay videos download on load (~22 MB desktop, 26.4 MB page)
Mobile layout viewport is 501px on a 390px device; header menu button is off-screen
quick_wins: Add metadataBase, canonical, openGraph and twitter to layout metadata
html { overflow-x: clip } to fix mobile overflow

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Static prerender with full SSR HTML

findings.title: No robots.txt or sitemap.xml
findings.description: Both return 404.

findings.title: No canonical tag
findings.description: No rel=canonical; Vercel preview hosts could be indexed.

findings.title: Mobile horizontal overflow
findings.description: innerWidth 501 at a 390px device; Services.js:21 x:+-120 start offsets; menu button off-screen.

findings.title: No crawlable internal pages
findings.description: All 50 anchors are #, tel: or mailto:.
findings.recommendation: Create service, work, privacy and terms routes.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: No CSP/XFO/Referrer-Policy; X-Powered-By exposed.

findings.title: Placeholder content in production
findings.description: Fake phone/address, 5 placeholder awards, 3 placeholder team members, 4 placeholder reviews, unverified stats.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real data or hide the sections.

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: No named people, location, verifiable clients, or social profiles.
findings.recommendation: Add leadership, HQ, app store links, real testimonials.

findings.title: Thin per-service content
findings.description: ~20 words per service on one page.

findings.title: No Arabic version
findings.description: English only for a Saudi audience.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique title and meta description present

findings.title: Brand-only title, short description
findings.description: Title has no service/geo term; description is 83 chars.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with service + Saudi Arabia; 140-160 char description.

findings.title: Split H2 fragments
findings.description: FEATURED/PROJECTS and THE MINDS BEHIND/LONG RELATION are separate H2s.

findings.title: Dead # links
findings.description: Blog, Terms, Privacy, socials and LinkedIn links point to #.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.description: 0 JSON-LD blocks.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService (draft in findings/schema.md).

findings.title: All videos download eagerly
findings.description: 21.9 MB of video fetched within 10s on desktop without scrolling.

findings.title: Heavy main thread on mobile
findings.description: 4.65s long-task time under 4x CPU throttle; mobile FCP/LCP 3.8s.
findings.recommendation: Defer non-critical animation setup; reduce JS.

findings.title: Intro loader on every visit
findings.description: ~2.5s splash before content is visible.

findings.title: Unoptimised fonts and preloads
findings.description: 395 KB fonts incl. TTF; below-fold SVGs preloaded.
findings.recommendation: next/font or subset WOFF2; drop the preloads.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Content server-rendered and readable without JS

findings.title: No AI crawler policy or llms.txt
findings.description: robots.txt and llms.txt both 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish robots.txt with an explicit policy; add llms.txt.

findings.title: Low citability
findings.description: Few verifiable, self-contained facts; no FAQ.
findings.recommendation: Add an at-a-glance facts passage and an FAQ.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present on content images

findings.title: Large PNG screenshots
findings.description: Up to 704 KB PNG; no width/height.

findings.title: Generic alt text
findings.description: Alts like 'Home', 'Product'.

findings.title: No OG image
findings.description: No social preview image.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Canonical, OG, Twitter metadata + OG image

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Privacy and Terms pages; real social links

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: GSC + Bing verification and sitemap submission
